ui-polish-capture.title: Polish: comprehensive UI capture
ui-polish-capture.description: Systematically screenshot every relevant page/state of the app on device. Output goes to doc/todo/ui-polish/captures/. Stage 1 of 2 — review agent will compare against design specs after.
acceptCriteria: projects/archive/20260422_ui-polish/captures/ contains organized screenshots covering: chat (empty, live task, completed, error, supplement, takeover-approval), capsule (all 4+ states), settings home + each sub-page, onboarding (each step), navigation drawer, sessions list
Each capture has filename indicating page+state (e.g. capsule_takeover.png, settings_llm_auth.png)
projects/archive/20260422_ui-polish/captures/INDEX.md lists every capture with one-line context
